 Judgment

(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD) Learned AGA accepts notice for respondent Nos.2 and 3.
2.

This appeal is filed by the beneficiary of acquisition under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act', for short) challenging the judgment and award dated 01.03.2019 and 12.03.2019 respectively passed in L.A.C. No.939/2017 by the learned I Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi, whereby the Reference Court fixed market value of the acquired land at the rate of Rs.5,40,000/- per acre.

sentences.text: 3. There is a delay of 742 days in filing the appeal, which is beyond the statutory permissible limit under the provisions of the Act.
4. In view of the judgment of co-ordinate Bench of this Court in M.F.A. No.102543/2022, disposed off on 23.09.2024, the present appeal is not maintainable.

Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed in terms of judgment of this Court in M.F.A.
No.102543/2022, dated 23.09.2024.

Sd/-
